title: The reverse Goldbach problem and a refined Zsiflaw--Legeis theorem
summary: We prove new results on the additive theory of reversed primes $\overleftarrow{p}$; that is, primes $p$ which are written backwards in a fixed base $b\geq 2$. In particular, we study a variant of Goldbach's conjecture, looking at representations of integers as the sum of primes and reversed primes. We show that: (1) Every large odd integer is the sum of a prime and two reversed primes ($N=p_1+\overleftarrow{p_2}+\overleftarrow{p_3}$).
